commit_scope: Heal the silent-arrival class: the session-start flows (counsel card, form-cli selection) no longer die on a stale fkwu seed; the seed's keepers run before the doors that need it.
evidence_refs: Observed 2026-10-18 in this worktree: the standing form/fkwu predated the pinned source and answered 'unsupported file extension' on every .bml door, so at session start the counsel card hook died silently and ensure_form_cli_native.sh exited 1 at the source-identity probe, leaving a 2026-08-06 cached form-cli selected that answers exit 0 with no output on every invocation.
Root cause: the script built fkwu only when missing, never when stale, and the counsel-card hook ran before the ensure hooks in .claude/settings.json SessionStart order.

Heal: ensure_form_cli_native.sh rebuilds the seed when runtime/fkwu-uni.c is newer than the binary and retries the source-identity probe once after a rebuild when the probe answers a refusal shape; SessionStart hooks reordered (carry_thread, ensure_form_cli_kernel, ensure_form_cli_native, counsel card, arrival, coord); the counsel-card hook carries its own one-line freshness guard so the card can never again fail silently.

Verified 2026-10-19 on this Mac: bash -n passes; the exact guarded hook command prints the full counsel card ending with this repo's private-ground boundary line; the healed ensure script run against the stale cache detected the identity mismatch and sent the build to the Form gate (its completion probe is the carrier answering a grounded ask).
fkwu runtime and JIT source are unchanged; the form gitlink is unchanged.

local_validation.summary: Script syntax checked (bash -n); the guarded counsel hook command ran end to end and printed the card; the healed ensure script detected the stale cache's identity mismatch and routed the rebuild through the Form gate.

ci_validation.summary: Structural checks only; host carrier and hook-order change.

e2e_validation.expected_behavior_delta: Every session arrival in any worktree gets a fresh seed before the doors that need it: the difficult-conversation counsel card always arrives, and the selected form-cli answers instead of standing silent.
test_flows: Start a session in a worktree whose submodule moved; the counsel card prints and form-cli ask answers.

phase_gate.blocked_reason: Host-arrival change; this field records progress rather than gating delivery.
